strategies.description: Upgrade log4j-core from version 2.14.1 to a vendor-supported version that includes the fix for CVE-2021-44228.
constraints: Upgrade must be performed to a vendor-supported version with remediation for CVE-2021-44228
strategies.rationale: CVE-2021-44228 is a critical vulnerability in log4j-core that allows remote code execution via deserialization. Upgrading to a patched version resolves the vulnerability.

strategies.description: Isolate the payment-api service from external network access to mitigate the risk of exploitation.
constraints: Network isolation must be applied to the payment-api service to prevent external access
strategies.rationale: By isolating the payment-api service, external access is restricted, reducing the attack surface for CVE-2021-44228.

strategies.description: Block the deployment of log4j-core version 2.14.1 in all environments to prevent exposure.
constraints: Deployment of log4j-core version 2.14.1 must be blocked in all environments
strategies.rationale: Blocking deployment of the vulnerable version prevents any new instances from being exposed to the vulnerability.

strategies.description: Implement continuous monitoring to detect deserialization events and anomalies related to log4j-core.
constraints: Monitoring must be configured to detect deserialization events and log4j-related anomalies
strategies.rationale: Monitoring provides early detection of potential exploitation attempts, enabling timely response.
